invariants.title: Money is integer cents, everywhere; one currency per order.
Nothing is paid without an approved bill; a bill on an order is approved only when it passes the match at that moment.
The match names its numbers and the tolerance that applied; a breach is a refusal, never a warning.
Stock enters only through a goods receipt, by core's stock door; receipts are immutable.
Loosening the match is a person's act; an agent never changes the tolerance.
Order prices freeze at issue; price differences are shown and posted to their own account.
The same vendor's same bill number is one bill.
Receiving more than is open is a refusal naming the quantities; services are never received.
Every write is a logged command with an actor; refusals are logged too.
The journal derives balanced: receipt to GRNI, approved bill to AP with variance, payment from AP.
Goods received and not yet on an approved bill are always listable with their value.
